create_translate_folder_dataset: create a TranslateFolder dataset builder from a directory of language-specific text files for translation
build_tf_data_dataset: build a tf.data.Dataset from a TranslateFolder split with optional shuffling
get_split_language_examples: get split names and language mappings from a directory of paired translation text files
list_examples_from_file: list text examples from a single file by reading all lines into a list
review_translate_folder_class: review the TranslateFolder class and its dataset builder methods for translation datasets
